reviews.text: Would give 5 stars before good vets but very expensive

I do not recommend this clinic at all. There are scammers working there. When I brought my pet there for an operation, I was told that the operation would cost 22,000 NOK. However, I received a bill of 27,936.00 NOK.

When I contacted the clinic and explained that I had not been informed that the price would be higher, they started asking about my insurance. They offered me a free consultation or to take an X-ray of the animal, but my money was not refunded.

If you have to choose this clinic, make sure to demand written documentation of the agreed price right away. I trusted what they said, and I feel cheated.
Nice group of people working here, top customer service

After trying several vets with our dog who was limping, we luckily came to Empet Storo. Surgeon Bjørn quickly figured out what the problem was, and operated on a partially torn cruciate ligament. The reception, treatment and follow-up have been absolutely superb, and the dog has become completely well. Highly recommended!

Stay away!!
Unprofessional as hell. No empathy.
Our kitty has now been euthanized.
Cannot stress how good and caring and helpful they are. Bjørn helped us so much in our dogs last moments and made a terrible experience into something less painful, with sincerity and patience.
The people who work at this animal clinic are welcoming and skilled.

The best veterinary clinic in Oslo!

Empet Storo was the regular clinic for our rabbits, Panda and Peanøtt, when we lived in Oslo – and we honestly wish we could have packed the clinic (and especially Anja) with us when we moved.

We haven’t yet found a veterinarian who can match her knowledge, care, and dedication. If you go to Anja – or to Empet Storo in general – you can be sure your animals are in the very best hands.

Truly one of the best veterinary clinics in Oslo and the surrounding area.

Good meeting with friendly receptionist/reception manager. Great veterinarian who gave good advice and pain relief for our 13-year-old adopted dog. The conclusion was to let him have good days, and if this changed, let him go. There was no mention of possible measures, but an honest feedback with regard to what was best for the dog. All personnel involved were experienced as safe, generous but clear. Left with a good experience. No one who wanted to "push" sales or unnecessary procedures for our four-legged friend who was told that his days of life are coming to an end. Definitely recommend this place.

Over the past 6 years, both I and my top priority & much loved dog have become very familiar with all the veterinarians at Embet Storo. We have had relatively frequent visits over the years as he has had, and continues to have, his challenges.. and I am/have become an "over the edge" worried dog 'mom'. Everyone at Storo always takes us seriously!
"The face outward" - that is, the receptionists/veterinarians meet us, without exception, with a smile, a confident phone voice and with understanding! The veterinarians are a fantastically composed group with very good competence/knowledge, and with a pleasant and balanced mix of seriousness & humor.
If I ever move to the moon with Dennis, we will still 'fly' to Storo when needed - THIS PLACE IS HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!! Thank you so much for being YOU! Grateful!

We had tartar removed from our cockapoo after a campaign that EMPET had. They also recommended that 7 teeth be extracted at a price of almost 20,000 kroner.

We had never done this before, and did not know anything about the price level for such operations. However, after checking around a bit, we received significantly different feedback from other animal clinics, where all of them suggested extracting 2-4 teeth. We ended up at the Veterinarian in Hurum who extracted 4 teeth (to avoid having to come back with the same problem in several years) and at a price of 2,500 kroner! Almost 10 times lower price than EMPET.

Absolutely crazy really - not only the price, but also because we are left with the feeling that they made the problem bigger than it was to make more money.

I had my rabbit neutered here and it went very well. At the follow-up check-up I asked a simple question about another health concern, but unfortunately I got a minimal answer. For this we needed a separate consultation for over 1000 NOK. I think it's strange, especially after spending so much money there. They also charged a good amount to grind his teeth. 1800 NOK because that seems like a lot, especially when he was already under anesthesia for the neutering. It feels like they are only interested in making money🥲🥲

Steer clear of this clinic. I am met by arrogant staff with mood swings that can be detrimental to some customers. I was very unlucky with a veterinarian who gave incorrect information about the dog's health, and who withheld facts, and …
